title: Eight-particle pairwise additivity: octagon of A, B, C at rest (crowd-8 test)
pitch: Tests whether the pairwise-sum law holds at N = 8, where it is untested (we have N <= 5). Eight particles of species A, B, C, cycling, at rest on a circle of radius 4 (adjacent spacing 3.06, diameter 8, all pair separations 3.06 to 8.0). Pre-registered: sum of pair coefficients over all partners, no three-body term. Discriminates pure pairwise sum (residual at tracker noise) from a multi-body term (residual growing with N). Would also give a candidate for the crowd-8 bounty (max_particles 8). Cost 1.32 credits per run at T = 2.
